reason: Value/transfer lens: the realistic public gain is about +0.0005..+0.0015 (central ~+0.0008). That is below the +0.002 bar and well inside LB noise (SD of a 2-run difference ~0.003). (1) The ceiling is overcounted. The idea's 2,929 'a_*' FN include a_tail 606, a_linefit 354 and a_taken 62. Those nodes EXIST in the raw ILP graph and are removed or moved by the tail (fn_anatomy_exp39.md), so a detection-map change cannot reach them. Only a_never 1,907 is detection-side: 1,907 x 7.37e-6 (1/135,729, exp39 lab) = +0.0141 ceiling. Of that, 44b6's 167 are under-segmentation of neighbours ~7 um apart (wf_ideas_v2/r2_critic.notes.md l.16), which averaging two maps does not split. x138's readmit and sub-threshold gapfill (DIFF.md) already target the 'faint in one frame, visible in neighbours' subset that future context would help most. (2) What +0.002 requires: ~271 net FN->TP = 14% of ALL a_never, with the node count frozen by the quantile guard (every peak swapped in pushes one out). A 1,907 x marginal-share 0.3-0.5 x net-fix 0.05-0.15 model gives +0.0002..+0.0011, times 1.5-2 for more misses on an unseen embryo. (3) The views are highly correlated. temporal_unet.py has NO temporal positional encoding, and the full-resolution stage's temporal block is Identity (l.51-75, 84-100). So pos-0 and pos-1 are the same function of (own frame, neighbour). The per-frame full-res skip path dominates localisation, and the neighbour enters only through per-voxel attention at 3.25/6.5 um grids, where motion is 1.8 um/frame. This fuses a 3rd axis onto a map that is already a 2-seed x 8-view ensemble (x138 cell 3: SECONDARY_DETECTION_WEIGHT 0.80). (4) The direct out-of-sample analogue is small. Changing the detector view set on a primary that never saw the videos gave +0.0007 (RESULTS.md l.90, axis-flip on friend_a_exp02_loeo20). The same change was +0.025 in-sample and a -0.001 tie on the LB (probe 19). Other detection-map ensemble changes: Z-flip LB -0.009, secondary detection weight 0.8->0.5 LB -0.002 (CONTEXT.md A4). discussions_summary.md l.132: every public gain from 0.941 to 0.947 was a further TTA stage, each at noise level. (5) The literature support does not apply here. Trackastra's 's=2 substantially degrades' is about the LINKER window. linajea's 7-frame model is a trained 4D U-Net, not a test-time mean of two W=2 outputs. (6) There is a transfer risk the idea misses: the V1284 head (+0.007 on x138) was trained on pos-1-view peaks. Moving peaks changes the head's input-offset distribution (unquantified). The count-only guard also leaves the lowdet 0.3, gapfill 0.5 and READMIT 0.965 pools uncalibrated for the fused map. (7) The adoption test cannot tell a real effect from noise. P(observed >= base+0.002 | true gain 0) = 25%, and | true +0.0007 = 33%. One slot would mostly measure noise, and a 'win' is 25% likely to be a false adoption. Private: same mechanism, same order (no embryo-specific offset involved, 44b6 crop redundancy irrelevant because there is no lab validation), so it does not rescue the idea. The idea's own claim of 'zero extra GPU' and identical calibration (no temporal PE) is correct. The problem is size, not sign.
fix_if_any: Make it measurable before spending a slot. (a) Run an honest held-out test with the B26 harness: PRIMARY := friend_a_exp02_loeo20 (trained on 6bba only, never saw 44b6), 12 LOEO-44b6 videos, official metric, TEMPFUSE=0 vs 1 with the quantile count guard. That is ~30 min on friend A's 5070 Ti (the B5 12-video run took 28 min). Kill gate: >= +0.003 there, because that detector has recall 0.86 and far more headroom than x138, so the LB gain would be smaller. Also report the peak-set IoU and the share of a_never recovered. (b) A cheaper variant with a byte-identical main graph: keep the pos-1 main node set and V1284 inputs unchanged, and use the pos-0 view (max or mean with pos-1) only to build the lowdet/readmit/gapfill candidate pool. This removes the head-distribution and node-churn risks and caps the effect at gapfill's 3% budget. It stacks with anything, but its expected gain is +0.000..+0.001. (c) Otherwise use it only as an F2 node-set diversifier with no expected-value claim, never as an F1 component.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0008 central (range +0.0000..+0.0015; P(true gain >= +0.002) ~ 0.10-0.15). Unresolvable with one LB probe (2-run diff SD ~0.003).
realistic_private_gain: +0.0008 central (range -0.0005..+0.0015). Same mechanism as public. The unseen-embryo ensemble effect may be slightly larger than in-sample, but the direct analogue (axis-flip views on an unseen-embryo primary) was +0.0007. The small negative tail comes from the V1284 head seeing shifted peak positions.
